articles.title: Zero Latency Launches 'Venue Success' Program to Boost VR Operator Performance
articles.summary: Zero Latency has introduced a dedicated support function called Venue Success, led by industry veteran Brett Bovio, offering its global network of VR venue operators hands-on guidance in revenue growth, pricing strategy, local marketing, and operational best practice. Bovio brings nearly two decades of LBE experience from Sky Zone, Level99, Apex Entertainment, and Walt Disney World. For FEC operators running free-roam VR, this signals a meaningful shift from pure technology licensing toward full business partnership support.

articles.title: iP2 and DreamWorks Animation Prove Theme-Park-Grade FECs Can Be Built at Urban Scale
articles.summary: iP2 Group and DreamWorks Animation have developed DreamPlay, a compact 3,000–5,000 sqm urban FEC format that delivers IP-driven immersive storytelling without the capital expenditure of a full theme park. The model was validated in Manila and is now scaling globally, directly addressing the tension FEC developers face between guest experience quality and financial feasibility. This is a significant case study for operators and investors eyeing urban family entertainment destinations.

articles.title: Chuck E. Cheese Adventure World Makes International Debut in Mexico
articles.summary: Chuck E. Cheese has launched its new Adventure World format internationally for the first time, opening in Mexico. The expansion signals confidence in the brand's evolved entertainment concept beyond its traditional US base. FEC operators should note how legacy brands are repackaging themselves for international growth through larger, more experience-driven formats.

articles.title: Painting with Light's Illumiware Offers Reusable Immersive Infrastructure for Seasonal Events
articles.summary: Belgian design firm Painting with Light has launched Illumiware, a standardized hardware platform that allows attractions to swap digital content across the same physical installation, eliminating the need for costly new builds each season. The system is aimed squarely at operators running seasonal events who need to transform spaces multiple times a year. Illumiware will debut at IAAPA Expo Europe, making it a product to watch for FEC operators seeking cost-efficient immersive upgrades.

articles.title: Texas' Biggest Family Entertainment Center Set to Open in Houston in 2026
articles.summary: A major new FEC billed as the largest in Texas is slated to open in Houston in 2026, signaling continued investor appetite for large-format family entertainment destinations in high-growth Sun Belt markets. The project underscores the ongoing trend of anchor FEC developments serving as retail center alternatives. Operators and suppliers in the region should monitor this opening closely for competitive and partnership implications.

articles.title: Indoor Entertainment Driving Attractions Boom Across the UAE
articles.summary: Indoor entertainment is identified as a key growth engine behind the UAE's expanding attractions market, with rising consumer demand for air-conditioned, year-round leisure options in the region. The article highlights how international FEC and attraction brands are increasingly targeting the Gulf market. This is a strong signal for suppliers and operators considering Middle East expansion.

articles.title: Slick City and Activeon Expand European Footprint with New Parks in Sweden and Austria
articles.summary: Slick City, the indoor slide-based attraction brand, is accelerating its European rollout through a partnership with Activeon, adding new parks in Sweden and Austria. The expansion illustrates how niche indoor active entertainment concepts are finding traction beyond their home markets. FEC operators in Europe should watch this format as a potential anchor attraction or competitive threat.

articles.title: Funlandia to Showcase Integrated Vertical Adventure Play at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026
articles.summary: Funlandia will present its integrated vertical adventure play solutions at IAAPA Expo Europe in London, highlighting how complex multi-level play structures can anchor FEC experiences. Its BE1ST Sports Center project in Shanghai demonstrates how climbing, gliding, and active play can be woven into a single cohesive destination. Operators planning new builds or refurbishments should consider this session and exhibit for inspiration on maximizing vertical square footage.

articles.title: New Multi-Attraction FEC Coming to LaPorte, Indiana with Bowling, Mini-Golf, and Arcade
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center is being developed in LaPorte, Indiana, featuring bowling, mini golf, arcade games, and additional attractions under one roof. The project follows the well-established multi-concept FEC model that continues to prove successful in mid-size markets. It represents another data point in the sustained national buildout of full-service FEC destinations.

articles.title: InPark Magazine Issue 111: 'Frictionless Future' Explores Technology-Driven Guest Experiences
articles.summary: The latest issue of InPark Magazine focuses on reducing friction in guest experiences, covering topics from AI-powered ticketing and in-park purchasing to immersive technology integration. Contributors include accesso and Jora Vision, making it a practical read for operators evaluating guest flow and technology investments. FEC operators will find actionable insights on simplifying the path from arrival to experience.

articles.title: Disney World Beta Tests AI-Powered Vacation Planning Tool Built on Google Cloud
articles.summary: Walt Disney World is piloting a conversational AI booking tool developed with Google Cloud that allows guests to receive personalized hotel and park recommendations through natural-language queries. While aimed at a theme park scale, the technology points to where guest-facing AI is heading across all entertainment venues. FEC operators should track this development as similar AI booking and recommendation tools will increasingly become table stakes for mid-market entertainment destinations.

articles.title: Six Flags, Plague Productions, and Warner Bros. Invest in Premium Interactive Halloween Horror
articles.summary: Six Flags has partnered with Plague Productions and Warner Bros. Discovery Global Experiences to launch The Conjuring: Beyond Fear, a premium-ticket interactive horror experience for the fall season. The collaboration highlights how theme parks and FECs are moving toward higher-margin, limited-capacity premium experiences during Halloween. Operators running seasonal scare events should study this IP-driven premium model as a revenue diversification strategy.

articles.title: Waterville Valley Resort Adds 18-Hole Mini Golf Course from Adventure Golf & Sports
articles.summary: Adventure Golf and Sports has designed and constructed a new 18-hole miniature golf course at Waterville Valley Resort in New Hampshire, adjacent to a new 16,000 sq ft Adventure Center. The project demonstrates how resorts are expanding FEC-style amenities to boost on-property dwell time and revenue. Mini golf suppliers should note this as a strong case study in resort-integrated course development.

articles.title: Tour Inside Launch's Massive New Entertainment Complex in Pensacola
articles.summary: A detailed look inside the new Launch Family Entertainment complex in Pensacola reveals a large-scale trampoline and indoor entertainment facility that is part of the brand's ongoing national expansion. The venue tour highlights attraction mix, layout, and the scale of investment Launch is deploying in new markets. FEC operators and developers can use this as a competitive benchmarking reference for large-format indoor entertainment builds.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment to Open at Golden Triangle Mall in Late October
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment is set to open a new location at the Golden Triangle Mall, continuing the brand's strategy of repurposing underutilized retail anchor spaces for indoor entertainment. The mall conversion model remains one of the most active development strategies in the FEC industry. Operators and landlords alike should note this as further validation of the retail-to-entertainment conversion trend.

articles.title: New Indoor FEC Opens in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee Over Labor Day Weekend
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center debuted in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee, timed to capitalize on the Labor Day holiday weekend traffic. The opening reflects continued strong demand for indoor family entertainment in growing Nashville-area suburban markets. Local operators should monitor guest response and programming strategies from this new entrant.

articles.title: IAAPI Pushes for GST Reform to Unlock Growth in India's Amusement Industry
articles.summary: India's amusement industry association IAAPI is formally calling on the government to rationalize GST rates applied to amusement parks and entertainment centers, arguing current tax structures suppress consumer demand and constrain investment. The lobbying effort highlights a significant policy lever that could dramatically expand India's FEC and attractions market if successful. International operators and investors eyeing India should follow this regulatory development closely.

articles.title: Designing for Neurodiverse and Non-Average Guests in Location-Based Entertainment
articles.summary: An opinion piece challenges LBE designers to stop building experiences for an imaginary average guest and instead account for the full spectrum of human needs, including neurodiversity, physical variability, and sensory differences. Drawing on behavioral research and military history, the article argues that most attraction environments are compromised by design. FEC operators investing in experience redesign or new builds should treat this as essential reading for guest experience strategy.

articles.title: Kings Island's Phantom Theater Wins Best New Family Attraction at 2026 Golden Ticket Awards
articles.summary: Kings Island's Phantom Theater: Opening Nightmare took top honors for Best New Family Attraction at the 2026 Golden Ticket Awards, widely regarded as the amusement industry's most prestigious recognition. The dark ride format continues to prove its appeal as a family-oriented anchor attraction. FEC and park operators evaluating new attraction investments should note the strong audience response to immersive, story-driven family rides.

articles.title: Dollywood Claims More 2026 Golden Ticket Awards Than Any Other Theme Park
articles.summary: Dollywood walked away from the 2026 Golden Ticket Awards with four honors, more than any other park, reinforcing its reputation as a best-in-class guest experience destination. The consistent recognition highlights how investment in theming, hospitality, and ride quality drives industry leadership. FEC operators and park developers can look to Dollywood's operational philosophy as a benchmark for guest satisfaction.

articles.title: Leisure Development Partners Publishes 2026 Europe Edition of 'The Experience Economist'
articles.summary: LDP has released its Europe-focused market research report, highlighting that the UK is on track to become the second-largest attractions market in Europe and that both the experiential and competitive socialising sectors are maturing rapidly. The free report offers benchmarking data for developers, investors, and operators making strategic decisions in the European market. FEC stakeholders with European interests should download this edition for planning and investment context.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Coming to Jacksonville's Southside
articles.summary: A new adventure park concept called NRG Adventure Park is planned for Jacksonville, Florida's Southside district, adding to the growing pipeline of indoor active entertainment venues in the Southeast. The development reflects continued investor confidence in the adventure park segment as a viable FEC format. Operators and suppliers active in Florida should take note of this emerging competitor and potential partnership opportunity.

articles.title: LLMs Are the New Search Engines: What Attractions Operators Must Know About AI Discovery
articles.summary: As consumers increasingly turn to large language models like ChatGPT to discover businesses and experiences, the traditional SEO playbook is becoming obsolete for attractions operators. The article explains that LLMs favor earned media from trusted publications over paid search, meaning brand visibility strategies must shift toward editorial coverage and authoritative content. FEC marketers and operators should reassess their digital discovery and PR strategies in light of this fundamental shift in consumer search behavior.

articles.title: New Indoor Mini Golf Attraction Opens in Cardiff City Centre
articles.summary: A new indoor mini golf venue has opened in central Cardiff, Wales, adding to the growing competitive socialising and entertainment landscape in UK city centres. The opening reflects the continued expansion of urban entertainment concepts in European markets. Operators and suppliers in the competitive socialising mini golf segment should note the UK's sustained appetite for this format.

articles.title: First Renderings Released for MADCAPS Entertainment Center in Maricopa, Arizona
articles.summary: New renderings have been revealed for MADCAPS, a planned entertainment center in Maricopa, Arizona, giving the local community and industry a first visual look at the concept. The project signals continued suburban market development in the Phoenix metro area, one of the fastest-growing regions in the US. FEC developers and suppliers tracking new build opportunities in the Southwest should follow this project's progress.

articles.title: Attraktion! Installs Full Product Catalogue at Polish Adventure Park
articles.summary: Attractions supplier Attraktion! has completed a comprehensive installation of its product range at an adventure park in Poland, showcasing how operators can build a diverse attraction mix from a single supplier partner. The project highlights the growing European market for adventure park concepts and the appeal of turnkey supplier solutions. FEC operators planning new builds or expansions in Europe should consider this as a vendor case study.

articles.title: Siam Park Reports 20 Percent Attendance Boost from Summer Siam Night Event
articles.summary: Siam Park achieved a 20 percent attendance increase by running Siam Night, an eight-week evening event series that transformed the park with a festival atmosphere after hours. The results demonstrate the significant revenue and attendance upside available to attraction operators who invest in nighttime and seasonal programming. FEC and water park operators should evaluate after-hours event strategies as a proven demand-generation tool.
